# Delimiters in the text

Plain text with {\++ this ++\}, {\-- that --\}, {\~~ a ~\> b ~~\}, {\== mark ==\} and {\>> note <<\}.

Inserted: {++x {\++ y ++\} z --\} w ~\> v++}{>>Ana Lima (2026-10-01T00:05:00Z)<<} and deleted: {--a {\-- b --\} c ==\}--}{>>Bo Chen (2026-10-01T00:10:00Z)<<}.

A comment {==on {\== text ==\}==}{>>Carla Duarte (2026-10-01T00:15:00Z): Note with <<\} and {\>> inside and ++\} too<<} here.

Split across runs: a -**-}** and {_++_ and ~**>** end.

An insertion ending in a dash{++ -++}{>>Ana Lima (2026-10-01T00:20:00Z)<<}-} right after it.

Math-like text {++$x_{\--\}$ and $y^{\++\}$++}{>>Ana Lima (2026-10-01T00:25:00Z)<<} stays.
